# Avali
[color=#ffa500]Warning! This species is not recommended for new players due to major gameplay changes![/color]
Avali are a species of ammonia-based intelligent bird/raptor people. Due to this odd combination, and the fact that they are carnivores, many refer to them as "Space Raptors". Their unique biology allows them to deal exceedingly well with the cold, and is capable of basic flight in no to low gravity environments.
## Racial Features
- Receive [color=#ffa500]40% more fire damage[/color] and [color=#1e90ff]40% less cold damage[/color]. - Can stand in tempatures of up to [color=#1e90ff]-50c before taking cold damage[/color]. - Deal [color=red]6.25[/color] slashing damage with claws. - Can fly in Zero-G. - Slightly faster. - [color=#ffbc48]Nanite Technology![/color] Can encase themselves in a [color=#ffbc48]Nanite Shell[/color] for up to a minute. It holds their bleeding and slowly mends wounds, but they can't move in it and it does not soften a hit. - 2x Hunger rate, stay fed! - Can only eat meat-related food items (including organs) and pills. - Heal airloss from Ammonia and Amoxla but.. - ..Saline, Dex and Dex+ is lethal to you. Remember to remind doctors about it! - Fall into crit at 90 and dead at 180.
## Feathers
Use the context menu to [color=#1e90ff]preen your own or another Avali's feathers[/color]. Preening takes five seconds and stops if you move or take damage. Avali have up to three feathers available, regrowing one every two and a half minutes after the last feather was removed. A brute injury can tear out a bloody feather and grant three seconds of [color=#1e90ff]adrenaline[/color], temporarily ignoring injury slowdown. Shed feathers keep their owner's color and DNA. They can be used as quills or worn in the head or ear slot.
## Flight
This species is capable of flight on planets and other areas with altitude. Read the Flight entry for more information.
